unemployment.title: Unemployment
unemployment.hubSummary: Explore Georgia’s annual unemployment data: the national picture and comparisons across regions, age groups and gender.
unemployment.page.overview.title: Unemployment overview
unemployment.page.overview.summary: National unemployment and labour-force trends, with supporting views by urban/rural settlement, education and unemployment duration.
unemployment.page.regions.title: Unemployment by region
unemployment.page.regions.summary: Select a region on the map or in the list to explore its unemployment and labour-force trends. The map shows the latest published unemployment rates.
unemployment.regionSummary: Explore {region} unemployment and labour-force trends. Select indicators to compare rates or people counts over the region’s published years.
unemployment.regionalComparisonSummary: Select regions and indicators to compare rates or people counts. Historical combined regions remain separate, with unavailable years shown as gaps.
unemployment.page.age.title: Unemployment by age group
unemployment.page.age.summary: Compare unemployment, employment and labour-force participation across age groups from 2020 onward.
unemployment.page.gender.title: Unemployment by gender
unemployment.page.gender.summary: Compare women’s and men’s unemployment, employment and labour-force participation with Georgia’s total.
unemployment.summary: Georgia’s annual unemployment, employment and labour-force survey estimates, with published group comparisons.
unemployment.indicator.long_term_unemplo: Long-term unemployment rate (% of labour force)
unemployment.unitSelectionNote: Selecting a rate clears people counts; selecting a people count clears rates. Select all uses the current unit.
unemployment.unitFlipToCount: Switching to people counts cleared the rates.
unemployment.unitFlipToRate: Switching to rates cleared the people counts.
unemployment.employmentStatusNote: Employed people include hired employees, the self-employed and a small unclassified worker group. The two subcategories therefore do not add up to the full total.
unemployment.regionalEmploymentStatusNot: Hired and self-employed counts are available for {start}–{end}. Earlier years are unavailable.
unemployment.emptySelection: Select at least one series to display the data.
unemployment.emptyRange: The selected groups have no published observations in this period.
unemployment.compositionNote: Georgia · thousand persons · employed, unemployed and outside the labour force. These three groups make up the survey population; this national context is independent of the selected comparison groups.
unemployment.compositionAria: Georgia’s survey population aged 15+: stacked annual counts of employed, unemployed and people outside the labour force, in thousand persons
unemployment.ageNote: Five-year age groups and the 65+ group are shown from 2020 onward.
unemployment.ageHeatmapNote: All age groups, using the indicator and years chosen above. Stronger colour means a higher value; each cell shows the figure to one decimal. Missing observations appear as a dash.
unemployment.regionNote: Separate Imereti and Racha-Lechkhumi/Kvemo Svaneti begin in 2019; separate Samtskhe-Javakheti, Guria and Mtskheta-Mtianeti begin in 2017. Earlier combined regions remain distinct.
unemployment.educationNote: Education rates begin in 2020. Each rate uses its matching education/sex denominator. The reference is separately published; education counts and No education rates are unavailable.
unemployment.longTermNote: Long-term means 12 months or more. The rate is a percentage of the labour force; the share is a percentage of all unemployed people.
unemployment.sourceNote: Source: Geostat Labour Force Survey. Survey estimates, not census counts; displayed differences do not establish statistical significance.
unemployment.metaDescription: Explore Georgia’s official annual unemployment, employment and participation rates and counts by sex, age, settlement, region and education, with sources and Excel downloads.
